SUPPORT & REQUESTS

Contact Tripto

Need help with Tripto? Send a clear note and we will route it to the right place.

Last updated 16 September 2026
tripto.to
What we can help with
Account & access
Sign-in, account deletion and access questions.
Trips & bookings
Issues with a timeline, a saved booking or a forwarded confirmation.
Privacy requests
Questions about your data or a request to delete it.
Plus billing
For cancellation or plan changes, start with the secure billing portal in Account.
Include only what is needed

Tell us what screen you were on, what you expected and what happened. Do not include passport details, full payment-card information, booking confirmation numbers or document files unless we specifically ask through a secure channel.

Response and billing

Tripto support is handled by email. Subscription management and cancellation are handled in the Lemon Squeezy billing portal linked from Account for paid Plus users.

Still need help?

Write to us with the minimum information needed to understand your request.
